topic: Discount ka maths: 10% off ke baad contribution aur sales volume
caption:
₹500 ki item par variable cost ₹350 hai, to contribution ₹150. 10% discount price ko ₹450 karta hai; cost same rahe to contribution ₹100 bachega. 👇

Pehle jitna contribution kamane ke liye discounted price par 1.5× units—yaani 50% zyada units—bechne honge. Ye simplified example hai: variable cost/order same maan kar. Real offer se pehle demand, fees aur extra costs bhi dekho.

Discount dene se pehle per-order contribution calculate karte ho?

#BusinessJalwa #Pricing #SmallBusiness #ProfitMargin #Hinglish

scenes.narration: Paanch sau rupaye ki sale, teen sau pachaas ki variable cost. Har unit mein kitna contribution bachega?
scenes.question: Price ₹500

scenes.narration: Paanch sau ka das percent discount pachaas rupaye hai. Discount ke baad naya selling price chaar sau pachaas rupaye hoga.
scenes.question: 10% off = ₹50

scenes.narration: Agar cost teen sau pachaas hi rahe, to naya contribution chaar sau pachaas minus teen sau pachaas—sau rupaye bachega.
Pehle ek sale se sau nahi, ek sau pachaas contribution bachta tha. Ab sau bachta hai. Wahi total contribution rakhne ke liye डेढ़ guna units bechne honge.
Matlab pachaas percent zyada units—agar variable cost per unit same rahe. Discount se pehle apna target aur saare extra costs check karo.
